crossRefs.note: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
crossRefs.keyword: from pursuing him. Heb. from after him

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: When the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
translations.bsb: And when the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel, they turned back from pursuing him.
translations.kjv: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Israel, they turned back again from pursuing him.
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw that it was not the king of Israel, that they turned back from pursuing him.
